Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://aphc.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Andhra Pradesh High Court (AP High Court) for filling up District Judge positions through Limited Departmental Competitive Examination.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies available for the District Judge post in the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled offline application forms is 15-10-2026 up to 5:00 P.M. in the office of the Principal District Judge concerned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for AP High Court District Judge recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates must download the application form, fill it, attach enclosures, and send it through proper channels.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the District Judge post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Civil Judges (Senior Division) with not less than 3 years of qualifying service and a total service of 7 years in the judicial service.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to the District Judge positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is specified as 35 years as on 01.09.2026, while the minimum age is not specifically restricted beyond qualifying service requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary scale for selected District Judge candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the District Judge post will receive a handsome salary scale ranging from Rs. 144840 to Rs. 194660 per month as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AP High Court District Judge?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Computer Based Screening Test, a comprehensive Written Examination with multiple papers, followed by a Viva Voce interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid according to the official notification details provided for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to download the notification?
faq.answer: You can visit the official Andhra Pradesh High Court website at https://aphc.gov.in to access and download the official notification and application pro forma.
